thread.topic: [ENG] New application as Admin on the Minigame Server from Dream

posts.subject: [ENG] New application as Admin on the Minigame Server from Dream
posts.bodyHtml:
My name is Eetu Parkkonen, im from Finland and 15 Years old. I know im a little bit too young but i act like a adult. My hobbies are going skiing or meet my friends and i play Computer games. I really enjoy playing on the Dream Minigame Server, i have lots of fun and its a great Community. I played lots of time on the Dream Minigame Server and i have at the moment over 125000 Stamm Points. I really like this community, its great!! Really nice admins here and i want to be a part of the DreamTeam! I think you guys want to know, why let me be a part of the team?? The thing is i really love the server and i want to support the Minigame Server and i do it with fun:) Why dont support the best MG Server on the World? Im online between 14:00 and 18:00 daily and i will join the server whenever im able to! I think i dont need to speak German on the minigame server, like Snax said, because there are lots of players with another language. It will be [funny] to be the first or one of the first other language speaking admins. My english is OK, i think u can see it in this application, not that good but i hope its okey 🙂
Now something about my strengthes and weaknesses.


Strengths :
Im friendly
I help everytime when someone needs me
I learn now in school a bit german
Im a trusted guy
I can work in a team with other people very good.


Weaknesses :
If my screen freeze in a important situation, i start to be mad or rage sometimes 😄 Better u call police then.. haha**


And if User A call User B a son of a bitch, i will ask why he said that and if he gives not a normal answer or a shitty one, i think i will kick him then.



I hope this is a good application, im not as good as other people in english, but i tried. I will enjoy your feedback guys! Dream best Server ever [<3]
Hope i can be a part of the DreamTeam [<3]


- Paska :> [thanksforit*]  [dream*]  [thanksforit*]

I've got the same opinion like Gimme :>.
Well from my side its a no, this is a german community and not everyone here can speak btw understand english, so not being able to speak german is inacceptable^^ (This is only my opinion)

I have to agree with Khryptos.


An Admin is mainly there to keep all the Players calm and help them if they need help.


The thing is, imagine if there is a fight between two players via Voice-Chat, but they are speaking german, so you wont understand anything and that means you cant judge who of the two is the one that deserves the kick.


My opinion is, that on a german Server, where everybody speaks german you need to undestand it, otherwise the Admin is more or less useless.


Good Luck anyways !!
